_metadata.purpose: Reference Claude Desktop config for the universal CRM MCP server.
instructions: 1. Choose ONE of the variants below ('crm-local-stdio' OR 'crm-remote-http' OR 'crm-via-npx').
2. Copy the chosen entry under 'mcpServers' INTO your real config file.
4. JSON does NOT support comments — strip the '_metadata' block before saving.
5. Fully quit Claude Desktop (not just the window) and reopen.
6. Open any chat → click the plug/hammer icon → confirm 'crm' is listed.
7. Ask: 'List the CRM tools you have' to verify.
gotchas: Windows paths require double-backslash (\\). Forward slashes also work in most setups.
If 'command: node' fails with ENOENT, replace with absolute path (/usr/local/bin/node, etc.).
Token shown only ONCE at generation — store securely. Rotate periodically.
Remote HTTP variant requires Claude Desktop 0.7+ for native 'type: http' support.
Never commit this file to git — it contains real credentials.

crm-local-stdio._doc: Variant A — Local stdio. Single-user. Build the project first: npm run build inside crm-mcp/.

crm-via-npx._doc: Variant B — Local stdio via published npm package. Zero install.

crm-remote-http._doc: Variant C — Remote Streamable HTTP. Multi-tenant. Token resolves user+org server-side.
